sentences.text:
Author: Joymalya Bagchi
Bench: Joymalya Bagchi
 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
05.10.2024
 sdas
 43
 C.R.R. No. 3658 of 2024

In Re : Biswajit Patra & Anr. .....petitioners  Mr. Krishan Ray  Mr. Sekhar Mukherjee  Mr. Anindya Chowdhury  Mr. Subhajit Mukherjee  Ms. Isita Kundu  ....... for the petitioners  1.
Learned Counsel for the petitioners submits impugned criminal proceeding was initiated 16 years after marriage.
Allegations of cruelty and torture are general and omnibus.
2. I have considered the averments in the impugned FIR in the light of the aforesaid submissions.
Allegation of torture is generic in nature.
Petitioners have made out an arguable case in their favour.

3. Copy of the petition be served upon opposite party 1/State through learned Public Prosecutor,
High Court, Calcutta and opposite party no. 2 through registered speed post with acknowledgement due and affidavit-of-service be filed on the next date of hearing.

4. Let this matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" four weeks after Puja Vacation.
5.

There shall be stay of operation of the proceedings being Jharkhali Coastal Police Station Case No.
83 of 2023 dated 18.09.2023 under Sections 498A/406/323 of the Indian Penal Code subsequently charge-sheet being no. 77 of 2023 dated 28.10.2023 submitted by the investigating agency under Sections 498A/406/494/323 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition CRR/3658/2024 on 5 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158628373/
1 Act pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 6th Court at Alipore, South 24 Paragans for a period of six weeks after Puja Vacation or until further orders whichever is earlier.
6. Liberty is given to the parties to pray for extension and/or vacation and/or modification of this order upon notice to the other side.
7. Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, shall be given to the parties as expeditiously as possible on compliance of all necessary formalities.
(Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
CRR/3658/2024 on 5 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158628373/
